description: Clean and alter the provided summary text as follows: 1) Based on provided variable `pov` value, I alter, the voice of the summary: 1=first-person, 2=second-person, 3=third-person, 4=first-person plural--if the summary content is already in this voice, no alteration is needed; 2) if variable `anonymous` is true, I change all instances of `memberName` (variable also provided) to correct `pov` pronoun (I, you, he/she/they, we); 3) I return any content `warnings` that apply to the summary, or leave blank no flagged content.
name: prepareSummary

preparedSummary.example: summary= "John Doe works at Google"; anonymous=true; memberName="John Doe"; pov=3; preparedSummary= "He works at Google"

warnings.description: Comma-delimited list of content warnings that apply to the provided summary, or leave blank no flagged content
warnings.example: violence, adult language, adult content, drug use, alcohol use, sexual content (etc)
